city.panel.help.boosters_body: Match 4: Line Bolt (clears row/col). L or T match: Surtr Bomb (3x3). Match 5: Bifrost Shard (swap with any rune to clear all of that color). Swap two boosters for mega combos!
city.panel.help.obstacles_body: Ice Plates: match over them (1-2 hits). Fenrir Chains: match the chained rune to break free. Frost Crates: match next to them or blast with tools. Relics: drop them to the bottom row.
city.panel.help.village_body: Rebuilding structures grants permanent bonuses (Max Endurance, Score, Spoils, Extra Moves) and unlocks Mastery Boards. Every victory discovers relics for Nine Realms chests!

building.forge.desc: Tempers sacred weapons and runic hammers for tough boards.
